tasks_completed.rationale: happy-daemon-dev.service has KillMode=control-group. `systemctl restart` from within the cgroup (this subagent is a descendant of MainPID 400414) SIGTERMs the entire tree including this subagent. Running the restart through `systemd-run --scope` places it in a new transient scope, outside the old cgroup — the restart survives the SIGTERM sweep and completes cleanly. The script writes all verification data to known files so QA and the orchestrator can read them after this subagent terminates.
